title: [review] 03-adaptation.md: DIO/DAO sizes inconsistent with app
description: States 'DIO 40 bytes, DAO 37 bytes' but appendix-schc.md lines 15-16 show 'RPL DIO | 8 bytes' and 'RPL DAO | 6 bytes'. The values may represent different metrics (total packet vs residue), but this ambiguity could cause implementation confusion.
